doc.name: Septic Log
doc.description: A maintenance record for a septic system: log inspections, pump-outs and the sludge and scum levels a service provider measures, and compute the next inspection and pump-out window from the intervals published by the US EPA. No LLM, no AI - dates and arithmetic only. It does not judge code compliance, and it does not measure anything itself. This service is a plain REST API and an MCP server over Streamable HTTP - it is NOT an A2A JSON-RPC agent. Docs at the documentationUrl.

skills.name: Check a septic service record
skills.description: Check a list of septic system service events for things that cannot be true, and return the next inspection date and pump-out window computed from the EPA intervals. REST: POST https://septic-log.rowb.app/api/check-record (bearer key). MCP tool: check_service_record (anonymous allowed).

skills.name: Get the rule table and its source
skills.description: The exact rule table, the verbatim quotes from the EPA page every interval comes from, and what this service explicitly does not claim. MCP tool: get_rules.
